Oceanic LurkPassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of each wave, Jeri gains [Stealth] for 2 turns. If Jeri is under [Stealth] status or considered as under such status at the beginning of her turn, restores all allies' HP by 6% of Max HP. Also, if Jeri isn't under [Stealth] status when an enemy gains [Stealth], Jeri has a 60% chance to steal the enemy's [Stealth]. This chance is not affected by Effect RES or Effect Hit.
Oceanic Necklet Lv.2When Jeri is under [Stealth] status or considered as under such status, reduces her Direct DMG and DoT taken by 20% and blocks any debuff from enemies.
